title: Especialista em Operações Jurídicas
description:
Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo!

A EasyJur é uma legaltech que está transformando a advocacia através da tecnologia. Nossa missão é eliminar 10 bilhões de horas de trabalho repetitivo para 2 milhões de advogados até 2033, redesenhando a forma como escritórios e departamentos jurídicos operam. Estamos em ritmo acelerado de crescimento e buscamos um líder de operações para levar nossa estrutura ao próximo nível.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Especialista em Operações Jurídicas para atuar no núcleo da operação, garantindo organização, disciplina e excelência na execução dos fluxos. Este profissional terá papel essencial na estruturação, supervisão e auditoria da operação, assegurando previsibilidade, qualidade e padronização em grande escala.

É um perfil de alto nível técnico, com experiência consolidada em gestão de correspondentes, prazos e logística jurídica, apto a mitigar erros e dar sustentação à operação em ritmo de crescimento acelerado.

Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar fluxos e processos operacionais, garantindo padronização, clareza e eficiência em todas as etapas da operação.
  • Auditar rotinas e controles internos, supervisionando a qualidade das entregas e assegurando conformidade com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Supervisionar e coordenar o time de analistas, fornecendo direcionamento técnico, acompanhamento contínuo e promovendo desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Mitigar erros e intercorrências operacionais, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva para manter a previsibilidade e confiabilidade da operação.
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de audiências, diligências e prazos, assegurando precisão e qualidade.
  • Controlar e organizar a atuação de correspondentes jurídicos em diversos estados.
  • Realizar auditoria de atas, conferência de informações e alinhamento direto com clientes.
  • Implementar e monitorar planilhas, relatórios e controles de performance da operação.
  • Garantir aderência aos procedimentos internos e às melhores práticas de logística jurídica.
  • Apoiar a gestão na identificação de gargalos operacionais e propor melhorias de processo.
  • Atuar com disciplina e previsibilidade, assegurando o cumprimento de SLA’s e metas da operação.
  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs estratégicos e operacionais, garantindo que as metas sejam atingidas com previsibilidade.
  • Liderar o planejamento e execução de projetos estratégicos, integrando operações com Produto, Vendas e Marketing.
  • Implementar metodologias ágeis e ferramentas que aumentem a eficiência operacional.
  • Ser parceiro estratégico da liderança executiva, apoiando na definição e execução do plano de crescimento da equipe.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência consolidada em operações jurídicas e/ou contencioso em massa (logística de correspondentes, gestão de audiências, controle de prazos).
  • Domínio avançado de planilhas e relatórios de controle (Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI).
  • Perfil organizado, disciplinado, detalhista e orientado a processos.
  • Boa comunicação, postura colaborativa e capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e parceiros.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de crises.
  • Histórico em estruturação de processos, governança e projetos complexos.
  • Diferencial : experiência em operações de alto volume, gerenciando dezenas de audiências simultâneas por dia.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente inovador e desafiador, com oportunidades para impactar diretamente a transformação do setor jurídico.
  • Cultura colaborativa, onde você terá autonomia para implementar melhorias e influenciar estratégias da empresa.
  • Acesso a tecnologias de ponta e metodologias ágeis aplicadas ao setor jurídico.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido/remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade e qualidade de vida.
  • Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo.

Sobre a EasyJur e nosso DNA

Somos movidos por coragem, inovação e impacto. Nosso propósito é transformar o mindset da advocacia, proporcionando eficiência e tecnologia para que advogados possam se dedicar ao que realmente importa: garantir a justiça​. Buscamos profissionais apaixonados por desafios, que pensem grande e queiram crescer conosco!

Se você quer fazer parte dessa revolução no Direito, inscreva-se e junte-se à EasyJur!

title: Analista de Custos Sênior
description:
Resumo do Cargo

Reportando-as ao Supervisor de Controladoria, é responsável pela consolidação dos custos industriais, validação de KPI’s financeiros para Operações, incluindo consolidação, validação, análise e preparação de relatórios, garantindo a qualidade dos dados e desenvolvimento de ferramentas para suportar estas atividades.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Consolidar os custos industriais das plantas da Ardagh nos processos de fechamento mensal, Budget e Reforecast trimestral, garantindo acuracidade das informações;
  • Preparar análises das variações e entendimento dos principais drivers de flutuação em cada mês, consolidando comentários para a gerência e diretoria de FP&A e operações;
  • Realizar a modelagem de retorno financeiro de projetos, incluindo demandas comerciais que envolvam customizações de produto;
  • Validar os KPI's financeiros que impactam na gestão das plantas, através da extração de dados de consumo, custos e modelagem em Excel;

Formação

Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Engenharia ou Economia.

Requisitos

Inglês intermediário;

SAP – módulos FI (desejáveis), CO e FM (desejáveis);

Excel avançado;

Conhecimento em SAP FI e desejável CO/FM;

Conhecimento de custos industriais e rotina fabril;

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Desenvolvedor Laravel Vue Junior (jr)
description:

  • Conhecimento em Git

Além do salário, temos alguns benefícios:

title: Coordenador de Prevenção a Fraude
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma plataforma líder em monetização de conteúdo no Brasil, com operação financeira de alto volume e crescente complexidade. Esse cenário exige uma estrutura robusta de Prevenção a Fraudes , capaz de proteger o negócio, os usuários e os creators.

Por isso, buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Prevenção a Fraude para assumir a liderança da área, com foco em performance operacional, mitigação de riscos e evolução contínua das estratégias antifraude.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de operação de monitoramento e investigação de fraudes financeiras .
  • Atuar com foco em performance , aumentando a eficiência da mitigação de fraudes e reduzindo perdas financeiras.
  • Monitorar a atuação de Sellers , identificando comportamentos suspeitos e conduzindo investigações estruturadas.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir estratégias, ferramentas e processos antifraude , com base em dados e indicadores.
  • Criar, revisar e documentar normas, políticas e procedimentos operacionais de prevenção a fraudes.
  • Produzir indicadores, relatórios e análises para embasar decisões estratégicas e definição de ações.
  • Atuar de forma transversal com áreas como Dados, Produto, Tecnologia e Jurídico , garantindo alinhamento e governança.

O que valorizamos

  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Atitude investigativa, curiosidade e atenção a detalhes.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e foco em padronização.
  • Facilidade para atuar de forma transversal com diferentes áreas.
  • Liderança colaborativa, com senso de dono e autonomia na condução da área.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em gestão e desenvolvimento de estratégias de prevenção a fraudes .
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de times de operação antifraude .
  • Vivência em operações de prevenção a fraudes com foco em Sellers .
  • Experiência prévia em prevenção ou investigação de fraudes, preferencialmente em meios de pagamento, e-commerce, marketplaces ou plataformas digitais .
  • Conhecimento sólido de ferramentas antifraude, regras transacionais e indicadores de risco .
  • Vivência com análise de dados e identificação de padrões suspeitos (SQL, Excel, BI).
  • Capacidade de redigir normativos, procedimentos e documentação técnica .
  • Formação superior completa.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Segurança da Informação e Compliance .
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala e operações financeiras complexas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e Ondontológico – (disponível para empresas com CNPJ ativo há pelo menos 6 meses);
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo, com forte foco em inovação, aprendizado e impacto estratégico.

Por que entrar na Privacy

A área de Prevenção a Fraudes é estratégica para o crescimento sustentável da Privacy.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma operação crítica , evoluir estratégias antifraude e influenciar diretamente decisões que protegem o negócio e os usuários em larga escala.

Se você busca um desafio de liderança, com impacto real e alto grau de autonomia, essa vaga é para você.

title: Analista Planejamento Operacional Jr
description:
Sobre a GRU Airport

A GRU Airport , conhecido como o maior aeroporto do Brasil, conecta sonhos, destinos e oportunidades há quase quatro décadas.

Reconhecido como o principal hub da América Latina, a GRU Airport , administradora do Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo, em Guarulhos, é referência em eficiência e conectividade. Porta de entrada do Brasil para o mundo.

Nossa infraestrutura e nossos serviços garantem uma operação contínua, segura e de qualidade, atendendo às necessidades de passageiros e empresas. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza a inovação, o desenvolvimento e o impacto positivo na jornada de cada viajante, venha construir o futuro conosco no setor da aviação.

Na GRU , acreditamos que cada colaborador é fundamental para alcançar novos patamares.

Descrição:

O Analista de Planejamento Operacional Júnior atua em atividades rotineiras de coleta, tratamento e organização de dados operacionais. Colabora na produção de relatórios, painéis e bases que subsidiam análises da área, além de acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e processos de atualização de parâmetros operacionais. Sua atuação concentra-se na execução de tarefas de suporte técnico e na manutenção de informações necessárias para estudos sobre infraestrutura, desempenho e eficiência do aeroporto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na coleta, tratamento e análise de dados operacionais relacionados à movimentação de passageiros, aeronaves e utilização de recursos.
  • Executar rotinas de monitoramento e atualização de indicadores operacionais e de desempenho (ex: pontualidade, tempo de conexão, ocupação de áreas).
  • Realizar cálculos estatísticos para análises comparativas e acompanhamento de padrões de comportamento da demanda.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e dashboards para diferentes áreas da operação.
  • Apoiar a construção de cenários de previsão de demanda e simulações operacionais sob orientação de profissionais plenos ou seniores.
  • Contribuir com o mapeamento da infraestrutura aeroportuária e dos parâmetros mínimos de dimensionamento estabelecidos pela ANAC.
  • Auxiliar na preparação de estudos relacionados ao fluxo de passageiros e à alocação de recursos operacionais.
  • Atualizar bases de dados, plantas e ferramentas de controle utilizadas no planejamento operacional.
  • Participar de reuniões com áreas operacionais e externas, contribuindo com dados e insumos analíticos.
  • Apoiar na realização de diagnósticos sobre capacidade de terminais e gargalos operacionais.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

FORMAÇÃO/ EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Ensino superior completo (desejável Administração, Engenharia, Logística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Desejável Inglês Intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário de pacote Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento básico de Power BI;
  • Desejável experiência atuando nas áreas de Planejamento ou área Operacional;
  • Desejável experiência básica dos processos operacionais no Terminal de Passageiros e Lado Ar.

CONHECIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS / HABILIDADES

Desejável conhecimento básico da documentação:

  • Legislação ANAC - Agencia Nacional de Aviação Civil, que envolve atividades de alocação de SLOT;
  • OACI - International Civil Aviation Organization;
  • International Air Transport Association – IATA que envolve atividades de alocação de SLOT;

Desejável conhecimento genérico de:

  • Capacidade dos Terminais de Passageiros;
  • Tipos de aeronaves comerciais em operação em relação à capacidade de posições de Pátio;
  • Conhecimento básico de estatística.

Facilidade de relacionamento com diversas entidades públicas, privadas, incluindo empresas aéreas, empresas auxiliares – ESATAS entre outros;

Facilidade em elaborar apresentações.

Pacote de Atrativos

Salário Compatível com o Mercado;

⏰ Jornada de Trabalho 40 horas semanais - Seg a Sex 08:30 - 17:30 (1 hora de intervalo)

️ Vale Refeição: R$ 1.255,78 mês;
company: GRU Airport - Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo

title: Demand & Business Planning Specialist
description:
Empresa multinacional do setor de alimentos , de grande porte e com atuação regional, busca profissional para atuar em Demand & Business Planning, com foco em previsão de demanda, análise de volumes e participação em processos integrados de planejamento.

Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas comerciais, planejamento e operações.

Apoiar análises pontuais e iniciativas de melhoria dos processos de planejamento.

title: LATAM Sales Manager - Pathology Diagnostics
description:
Location: Latin America (Fully Remote / Open to Brazil, Peru and Colombia)

Reporting to: US Head of International Business

Company Introduction

  • Celnovte Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a fast-growing global developer and manufacturer of pathology diagnostic reagents and automation instruments, specializing in Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In-Situ Hybridization (ISH).
  • With our proprietary MicroStacker™ polymer detection technology and a full portfolio of automated IHC stainers (CNT300 / CNT320 / CNT360), Celnovte provides clinical-grade solutions comparable to leading international brands, while offering greater flexibility and value for emerging markets.
  • Today, Celnovte products are installed in 2300+ laboratories worldwide, supporting hospitals, reference labs, and pathology centers across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America.

Position Overview

  • We are seeking an experienced LATAM Sales Manager to drive business growth across Latin America, focusing on pathology automation instruments and IHC reagents.
  • This role combines direct sales, distributor management, and market development, with strong autonomy and regional responsibility.

title: Engenheiro Geotécnico Pleno
description:
Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1000 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes.

O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia-a-dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar estudos e projetos geotécnicos: sondagens, análise de estabilidade de taludes, fundações, muros de contenção e reforço de solos;

  • Dimensionar soluções geotécnicas e elaborar relatórios técnicos;
  • Apoiar a compatibilização de projetos com outras disciplinas (drenagem, pavimentação, estruturas);
  • Acompanhar obras e realizar visitas técnicas para inspeção e validação de hipóteses de projeto;
  • Utilizar softwares de geotecnia como GeoStudio (Slope/W, Seep/W), Plaxis, entre outros;
  • Auxiliar no controle de qualidade de documentos técnicos da disciplina.

Requisitos:

  • Superior em engenharia civil;
  • Experiência em projetos geotécnicos em rodovias/ferrovias de pelo menos 5 anos;
  • Conhecimento consolidado em softwares de análises de estabilidade como Slide/slope;
  • Conhecimento consolidado em softwares de modelos numéricos como Plaxis/Phase.
  • Domínio do pacote office.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência em projetos de túneis tanto em solo como em rocha;
  • Especialização em geotecnia.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.

The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of supplier-manufactured components and systems used in RNG equipment. This role leads supplier qualification, audits, testing, and continuous improvement activities to maintain high quality standards across the supply chain.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Qualify, audit, and develop suppliers to ensure robust manufacturing and quality systems (NCR, CAPA, PPAP/APQP).
  • Assess supplier manufacturing capability and mitigate quality and delivery risks.
  • Drive supplier performance improvement aligned with quality, cost, and delivery targets.
  • Lead product and process qualification activities at supplier sites.
  • Plan and execute FAT and SAT activities for components and fully assembled RNG systems.
  • Review test procedures, validate instrumentation, document non-conformances, and issue acceptance reports.
  • Develop and implement inspection plans, test procedures, SOPs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage non-conforming supplier components and oversee root cause investigations using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa).
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable codes and standards (ASME, ASTM, AWS, NR13).
  • Identify cost reduction and quality improvement opportunities with supply chain and engineering teams.
  • Lead Kaizen and standardized work initiatives at supplier facilities.
  • Maintain accurate records of supplier processes, audits, test results, and corrective actions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, databooks, and management reports.
  • Partner with internal teams (manufacturing, purchasing, QA/QC).
  • Train and mentor quality personnel on qualification, testing, and inspection processes.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years in manufacturing or quality roles; 1–3+ years in Supplier Quality Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of integrated process systems (e.g., gas processing, upgrading systems, controls).
  • Strong technical capability with Supplier audits, FAT/SAT leadership, GD&T, P&ID interpretation, ISO 9001, root cause analysis.
  • Preferred with knowledge in standards as ASTM A516 Gr.70, ABNT NBR 6656 USI SAC 50, ABNT NR-12, NR-13, ASME VIII Div.1, ISO 2768-mK, MTC EN 10204 Type 3.1, ANSI class, AWS A2.4, ASTM A36, ABNT NBR 7007 MR250, and SSPC-SP6/SP10.
  • Experience working directly with customers and plant operators in on-site environments.
  • Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to leadership.
  • English proficiency required.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Finance & Payroll Specialist
description:
Finance & Payroll Specialist

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: 100% remote

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Our Firm:

Sterlington is a full-service law firm that combines legal and commercial excellence with modern ways of practicing. Our high-caliber partners work on complex business matters with a tailored approach to client service and a focus on financial flexibility and innovation. Learn more at:

The Opportunity:

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist who takes ownership and gets things done. This isn't just about processing numbers—it's about being a trusted partner to our finance team and ensuring our people and vendors are paid accurately and on time, every time.

If you're someone who thrives on precision, stays ahead of deadlines, communicates effectively, and brings solutions (not just questions), we want to hear from you. You'll play a critical role in supporting our US-headquartered service business, managing everything from multi-system payroll processing to partner distributions and year-end compliance.

What You'll Do:

Payroll

  • Prepare and reconcile monthly payroll summaries with meticulous accuracy
  • Record payroll bills and journals, and process payments efficiently
  • Drive improvements and consolidation across multiple payroll systems (XE, Gusto, Ramp)
  • Create and distribute monthly payment summaries to law partners
  • Calculate origination partners' monthly distributions and annual true-ups
  • Maintain flawless payroll records, including salary changes, bonuses, benefits, and tax deductions
  • Partner closely with HR to ensure employee data is current and accurate
  • Reconcile benefits and 401K deductions with precision
  • Register with state authorities as needed to ensure all state filings are current
  • Proactively monitor and resolve payroll system exceptions and tax-related issues before they escalate
  • Own year-end payroll reporting, compliance, and filings (W-2s, 1099s, K-1s)
  • Support workers' compensation and other audits
  • Prepare ad hoc and monthly management compensation reports as needed

Accounts Payable

  • Review, verify, and process vendor invoices, reimbursements, and disbursements with accuracy and speed
  • Receive and answer questions about payments from team members and vendors.
  • Track payment approvals and due dates, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks
  • Maintain and monitor vendor records with a keen eye for detail
  • Reconcile AP aging reports and support monthly close processes
  • Calculate recruiter fees accurately
  • Record and reconcile law partner credit card transactions
  • Manage intercompany reconciliation for credit card transactions, payables, and expenses
  • Track and report monthly business development expenses per partner
  • Follow up with partners and their assistants for missing or incomplete information
  • Ensure complete accuracy of prepaid account balances, client reimbursables, and team member advances

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in Payroll and Accounts Payable
  • US payroll expertise is essential. You must have hands-on experience with W-2s, 1099s, and K-1s, as well as all related state tax filings and registrations
  • Strong experience with payroll systems and maintaining accurate tax and state registration filings
  • Highly proactive mindset: you spot issues before they become problems and take initiative to resolve them
  • Exceptionally responsive, you understand urgency and prioritize accordingly
  • You take pride in completing your work with uncompromising accuracy, the first time.
  • You are a systems thinker and want to be part of the design process and program improvements within your area, and working across teams
  • Start-up / scale-up experience preferred
  • Professional services experience preferred
  • You are comfortable making systems change recommendations and assisting in the implementation of these changes.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment

Sterlington is a full-service law firm that combines legal and commercial excellence with modern ways of practicing.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.

  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.
  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.

In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written proficiency with English.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close & Core Accounting

  • Prepare and review journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Support the month-end close process following established checklists
  • Review P&L and balance sheet for accuracy before submission to the Controller
  • Maintain organized supporting documentation and workpapers

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
  • Perform basic variance analysis and flag inconsistencies
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reports and schedules

Accounting Operations

  • Review AP, AR, and credit card reconciliations
  • Support payroll processing and review prior to submission
  • Maintain and review the chart of accounts
  • Assist with recurring weekly and monthly accounting processes

Team Support & Review

  • Review work prepared by junior accountants or bookkeepers
  • Provide guidance, feedback, and basic training as needed
  • Ensure data accuracy and adherence to internal processes

Client & Internal Collaboration

  • Communicate with internal team members regarding open items and deadlines
  • Support client requests and questions under Controller supervision
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and escalate recommendations

Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules (such as PST, EST)

Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 2,500–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • Unlimited PTO after onboarding period (holidays included)

Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values:

  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

title: Especialista em Ciências de Dados
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade. O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

  • Plano de saúde - Paraná Clínicas: Priorizamos o cuidado com a saúde dos nossos colaboradores. Oferecemos um abrangente plano de saúde através da Paraná Clínicas, com planos com e sem custos e sem co-participação, assegurando acesso a serviços médicos de qualidade.

  • Incentivo à educação: Acreditamos no desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos colaboradores. Oferecemos incentivos à educação, apoiando a busca por cursos, treinamentos e graduações que contribuam para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.
  • PLR anual: Reconhecemos e valorizamos o empenho de nossa equipe no sucesso da empresa. Anualmente, compartilhamos os resultados positivos por meio da Participação nos Lucros e Resultados, proporcionando uma recompensa financeira adicional.
  • Programa Partnership: Na Valor Real, não vemos apenas colaboradores e prestadores, mas parceiros em potencial. Com o nosso inovador Programa Partnership, oferecemos a você a chance de se tornar um sócio da empresa, proporcionando uma trajetória profissional única e recompensadora.
  • Programa de indicação: Reconhecemos e valorizamos o poder das suas indicações. Com o nosso Programa de Indicação, ao recomendar nossos imóveis e contribuir para o crescimento da empresa, você é recompensado financeiramente.

title: Document Controller
description:
Company Brief :

At Cyient, we are driven by a singular purpose—to improve the daily lives of people around the world. Whether it’s enabling a quieter flight, a safer train journey, a more affordable medical device, or a faster internet connection, our unwavering focus is on creating meaningful impact through innovation.

We are a trusted provider of engineering, manufacturing, and asset & operations management services, partnering with industry leaders across the globe to solve their complex challenges. With over 16,000 employees across 20+ countries, we support 12 key industries, including Aerospace, Rail Transportation, Power Generation, Communications, and Medical Technology. With a strong track record of growth and profitability, we remain deeply committed to building a sustainable future—actively investing in education and inclusive growth initiatives within the communities we operate in.

Job Description:

The Document Controller will manage and maintain project documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational and industry standards. This role supports engineering and project management teams by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding technical and commercial documents across the project lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain document control systems (EDMS/DMS) for projects and operations.
  • Classify, index, and file documents (electronic and hard copy) with accurate metadata/attributes.
  • Monitor document workflows to ensure timely review, approval, and controlled distribution.
  • Maintain strict version control; ensure only current documents are in circulation.
  • Prepare and process transmittals; uphold document numbering procedures and naming conventions.
  • Coordinate submissions with internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Perform quality checks on deliverables (e.g., searchable PDFs, correct titles, revisions, attributes).
  • Generate regular status reports, registers, and KPI dashboards for document compliance.
  • Support audits and adhere to company QMS (ISO 9001)
  • Drive continuous improvement—cleanup duplicates/irrelevant files, optimize indexing and retrieval.

Required Attributes :

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in document control/records management in Oil & Gas/Offshore Drilling/EPC/EPCm industries.
  • Hands-on with EDMS/DMS platforms (ACONEX, Oracle UNIFIER, SharePoint Online, eRoom, Meridian).Experience with OpenText’ is preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and collaboration tools (Teams).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation (e.g., P&IDs, PFLOW, vendor drawings, data books, specifications).
  • Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines.

description:

O Consultor (a) Técnico Pl irá controlar e acompanhar carteira de clientes, realizando contatos telefônicos, por e-mail e visitas presenciais, analisando a elegibilidade dos projetos, avaliando as características técnicas, riscos, avanços tecnológicos em função de diretrizes, conforme manuais e procedimentos, a fim de classificar os projetos quanto a viabilidade do incentivo fiscal.

Como Consultor (a) Técnico Pl, você irá:

  • Responsável por contribuir para o bom funcionamento e o objetivo do SGSI - Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação da ISO 27001 e seguir as diretrizes de segurança das informações definidas pela direção e comitê. Responsável por contribuir para o atendimento aos requisitos e objetivos do SGQ - Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade da ISO 9001 e seguir as diretrizes definidas pela Direção;
  • Estudar a legislação, casos, serviços e produtos prestados pelo FI Group, através de leitura de guias internos, para obter conhecimento técnico e operacional, dentro dos procedimentos de consultoria, para condução da gestão de empresas categorizadas no mínimo com score C;
  • Efetuar alinhamento para mapear informações técnicas e os dispêndios envolvidos nos projetos, avaliando a tipologia e enquadramento, de acordo com o incentivo fiscal ou programa de fomento trabalhado, a fim de atribuir valor as atividades identificadas e calcular o benefício fiscal ou pleitear recursos para o cliente. De modo a garantir a rastreabilidade necessária perante os incentivos;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com foco nas áreas de conhecimento dos projetos, visando defender o conteúdo inovador e o enquadramento das atividades de PD&I na candidatura dos incentivos fiscais ou recursos para inovação Manter as ferramentas de gestão interna atualizadas, em tempo real, com informações referentes ao mapeamento da carteira de clientes, andamento dos produtos trabalhados e demais indicadores operacionais Seguir com analise critica da carteira;
  • Confeccionar e revisar dossiês econômicos, técnicos e finais para sua carteira de clientes, contendo balancetes e seus respectivos comprovativos econômicos, rastreabilidade contábil, relatórios, formulários e demais informações solicitadas pelos órgãos competentes. Assim como prestar suporte operacional e técnico aos outros consultores em todas as etapas do trabalho;
  • Realizar a apresentações junto aos clientes, com finalidades diversificadas, tais como início dos trabalhos, acompanhamento e finalização;
  • Participar de workshop e treinamentos internos para disseminação de conhecimentos e metodologias referentes aos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação, e externos para aculturamento a fim de identificar novas oportunidades dos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação. Realizar ações de relacionamento, visando fidelização da parceria.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About SpendHound:

  • is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research ().

About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.

We expect East work hours.

As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales

Role Summary

The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.

Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.

Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.

  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.

  • Habilidades de análise.
  • Proatividade.

title: Resource - Internal Controls - Centre of Excellence
description:
The role:

As the Internal Controls Resource, your role is to ensure the effectiveness of the Internal Control (IC) and Center of Excellence (CoE) framework across the subsidiary. This includes documenting and harmonizing processes, embedding internal controls, managing quarterly control self-assessments and continuous control monitoring (CCM), reviewing and closing internal/statutory audit observations, maintaining key policies (SOPs/DOA), and preparing relevant reports and dashboards for management. The role is critical for regulatory compliance and safeguarding company assets.

Responsibilities:

  • Document processes across the subsidiary and ensure harmonisation to the extent possible with global practices
  • Ensure necessary internal controls are incorporated in processes
  • Compliance - Running Quarterly/Monthly control self assessment and highlighting areas of improvement
  • Update the (Internal Control and Central of Excellence) IC - COE checklist on an ongoing basis taking into account changes in business and / or processes
  • Agree on the IC - COE calendar with the relevant stakeholders
  • Preparing IC - COE Dashboard for the subsidiary on a monthly basis and discussing potential issues with relevant stakeholders and developing an action plan. The Dashboard will incorporate activities contained in the IC - COE calendar including:

a. Status of Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM) - Monthly Controls

b. Status/closure of quarterly Control Self Assessment (CSA) Controls

c. Comments analysis and redressal

d. Preparation of CSA & CCM Dashboards, for major deficiencies to be shared on monthly basis - with management team

  • ICFR (Internal control for financial reporting)
  • Internal Audit /Statutory Audit observations review and closure of open points
  • Review of Executive summary of the completed audits.
  • Mapping of internal audit point with concerned department and owner
  • Mapping of owner name with IC-COE Control register
  • Discussion with the control owners to understand reasons of control failure and corrective actions
  • Supporting documents for Internal Audit as and when required related to GRC
  • Basis internal audit report, able to create and update ICCOE control risk matrix.
  • Regularly reviewing and updating ICCOE documents in line with changes in applicable laws and changes in organization structure.
  • Policy / SOP/Procedure / DOA follow up, maintenance and distribution:
  • Review and updating of Policies and SoPs yearly and on requirement basis after the discussion with FBPs and heads
  • DoA implementation, updating and maintenance across all the departments as per the OCN or on request basis by the FBPs
  • Interact and work in close coordination with Finance Process owners/ Other business process owners
  • Presentation and Data Analytical Capabilities are essential - Should be able to prepare board presentations and Analytics.
  • Coordination with statutory auditors for completion of quarterly / annual audits in areas involving controls, processes and procedures

Qualifications/ Experience:

  • CPA with 4 years experience in the big 4.
  • Person having end to end exposure of Procurement to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), CKD process, Fixed Assets Process, Inventory related process
  • Having understanding SAP is essential
  • working exposure in Internal Control or Internal Audit Department having similar exposure

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:

Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.

We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.

We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.

About the Project:

This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:

  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

Sobre a Empresa

A história do cooperativismo no Paraná é marcada por experiências de sucesso que uniram pequenos e médios produtores em torno de um objetivo comum: transformar a produção local em negócios sustentáveis de escala global. Nesse cenário, a Frimesa ocupa lugar de destaque. Fundada em 13 de dezembro de 1977, a cooperativa nasceu como Sudcoop, uma central formada por cinco cooperativas do Sudoeste do estado para industrializar carne e leite, garantindo renda e futuro para milhares de famílias. Quase meio século depois, a Frimesa se consolidou como uma das maiores indústrias do setor de proteína animal do Brasil, referência em carne suína e lácteos, com sede em Medianeira, no Oeste Paranaense. Hoje, o sistema cooperativo que sustenta a marca envolve mais de 24,6 mil pessoas, entre cooperados, colaboradores e famílias produtoras, em um modelo que alia competitividade, sustentabilidade e inovação.

Professional Experience/Qualifications:

  • development technology.

Required Skills / Experiences:

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Gainsight, including configuration, data modeling, rules engine, success plans, and reporting (or strong experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce).

  • Skilled at setting and communicating priorities effectively; able to manage multiple tasks and priorities

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Sales Operations Analyst will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, providing analytical support, and managing sales tools to ensure that our sales organization meets its targets. This role requires a blend of proactive thinking, operational expertise, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary contact and escalation point for the global Sales team for day-to-day sales operations needs.
  • Ensure due diligence is conducted on each new sales opportunity with proper analysis to ensure efficiencies prior to commencing the sales cycle.
  • Assist in clean up, maintenance, and enforcement of proper usage of CRM tool and ensure data accuracy and integrity within all internal systems.
  • Assist in managing the sales pipeline, coordinating and facilitating sales transactions.
  • Manage internal approval process of corporate contracts including calculation of deals’ as sold effective rates.
  • Coordination of internal approval process of corporate contracts including final documents review and summary set up in ticketing system (JIRA) and validation with necessary departments for contract approval
  • Work closely with Finance to provide oversight and execution of daily, weekly, and monthly reports, including pipeline management, sales analysis, win/loss analysis, and sales metrics.
  • Participate in qualification calls with the sales team and senior management and assist in capturing meeting notes and action items.
  • Help prepare presentations and materials for the global sales team as needed.

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience
  • Strong understanding and experience in working in a global sales team or with a global sales team
  • Familiarity with any Sales Force automation tool
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools
  • Proven experience managing simultaneous multiple priorities
  • Ability to partner cross functionally throughout the company
  • Strong MS excel and PPT skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English
  • Knowledge of business communication via emailing, presentations, conference meetings
  • Strong organizational and decision-making skills
  • University Degree required

title: Vendedor Prospectador
description:
Estamos recrutando para uma Agência de Campanhas Publicitárias que vende para grandes e médias indústrias e empresas da área financeira. Buscamos um novo VENDEDOR PROSPECTADOR , sedento por oportunidades que vai dominar as redes sociais para abrir caminhos e construir relacionamentos que geram valor.

Seu campo de batalha inicial será o LinkedIn e Listas de potenciais clientes, prospectando clientes B2B com precisão cirúrgica (prospecção social - social selling e prospecção fria em menor escala ). Você vai usar os perfis dos CEOs e diretores da empresa, então sua escrita precisa ser impecável — afiada, adaptativa, persuasiva quando necessário e digna de líderes. Também vai atender leads vindos de anúncios pagos, em menor escala.

Sua missão é clara: prospectar, monitorar, quebrar o gelo e agendar reuniões para o time comercial. Sua participação em vendas virá só depois que DOMINAR a prospecção e os serviços vendidos. Até lá o CEO da agência fará o fechamento dos negócios.

Se tiver esse instinto matador de "closer", ótimo, mas o que queremos é sua fome de conquistar leads. Históricos de sucesso, pessoais ou profissionais, pesam muito — e seus antigos chefes terão que te endossar.

Se essa descrição faz sentido e já deu vontade de mostrar serviço em uma equipe de alta performance, essa é sua chance. Inscreva-se e prove seu valor!

ATENÇÃO: Vaga pra dedicação exclusiva com a empresa. Esta questão é crucial e será monitorada a todo momento.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Vaga:

Social Seller - Especialista em Prospecção Digital

Descrição das atividades:

  • Prospectar ativamente no LinkedIn, identificando e engajando potenciais clientes B2B com base no Perfil de Cliente Ideal;
  • Monitorar o LinkedIn para captar sinais de interesse e oportunidades de negócios;
  • Quebrar o gelo com mensagens personalizadas e iniciar relacionamentos estratégicos, usando os perfis de CEOs e diretores;
  • Agendar reuniões comerciais para prospects qualificados, entregando leads quentes;
  • Quando estiver preparado: realizar reuniões de vendas e fechar negociações;
  • Preencher o CRM diariamente com todas as interações, mantendo o funil de prospecção organizado e atualizado;
  • Reportar diariamente suas atividades e resultados, com disciplina e foco em métricas;
  • Colaborar com o time de marketing para alinhar estratégias de geração de demanda;
  • Estar atento ao mercado, mapeando tendências e oportunidades no LinkedIn (e, futuramente, Instagram, se a estratégia da empresa evoluir para isso);
  • Dominar ferramentas básicas como Google Docs, Planilhas e Apresentações para organizar tarefas e criar relatórios simples;
  • Desenvolver uma rotina de alta performance, com consistência e foco em resultados agressivos.

Modelo e Remuneração:

  • Contratação de serviços como PJ
  • FIXO: Entre R$ 3.000,00 a R$ 3.500,00;
  • Bônus por metas de agendamentos alcançadas (a definir);
  • Comissão por vendas: ticket a partir de R$ 23k

Formato de trabalho:

  • 100% home-office, com metas diárias de resultados;

Perfil desejado:

  • Ambicioso — você quer vencer e não aceita meios-termos;
  • Focado em resultados — cada lead conquistado é uma vitória;
  • Resiliente — "não" é só um convite para tentar de novo;
  • Disciplinado — o home-office é seu território, e você o domina;
  • Criativo e estratégico — sabe seduzir com palavras e abrir portas;
  • Apaixonado por desafios — metas grandes te motivam, não te intimidam;
  • Senso de dono — trata cada tarefa como se o sucesso da empresa dependesse de você.

Habilidades:

  • Boa escrita — clara, persuasiva e adaptável ao tom de liderança (você irá responder por um dos diretores da empresa);
  • Boa comunicação oral para alinhamentos internos;
  • Persuasão e boa negociação;
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn (essencial) — 
  • Instagram é um plus, mas não obrigatório;
  • Domínio de ferramentas básicas de tecnologia: Vídeo conferências (Meet ou Zoom), Google Docs, Planilhas e Apresentações;
  • Perfil curioso e altamente investigativo — sabe garimpar leads e entender dores de prospects;
  • Organização impecável — gerencia contatos, tarefas e CRM como um profissional;
  • Raciocínio lógico e adaptável para adaptar respostas em casos específicos e visando converter leads.

Conhecimentos desejados:

  • Familiaridade com metodologias de vendas (SPIN Selling, gatilhos mentais, Receita Previsível, etc.) é um diferencial, mas não pré-requisito — se souber, ótimo; se não, vamos te testar na prática;

Formação desejada:

  • Cursado ou cursando ensino superior (administração, marketing, comunicação, gestão comercial ou afins) — não é obrigatório , mas agrega valor;

Experiências desejadas:

  • Histórico de sucesso em projetos pessoais ou profissionais é muito valorizado — traga resultados concretos para mostrar;

Requisitos para contratação:

  • Antigos chefes / líderes diretos de projetos que tenha participado serão contatados para endossar sua conduta, ética e desempenho;
